title: Provider Manual — Authorizing and Delivering Personal Care Hours in Care Management
content:
Personal care and respite hours in Care Management are authorized and delivered under the tier's hours schedule and the provisions below. The member's personal care hours balance is the hours authorized for the current period and not yet delivered or expired.

## Provisions

1. **Authorization.** Personal care hours are authorized per authorization period of the tier's length, up to the tier's weekly maximum of personal care hours; respite is authorized up to the tier's respite hours per calendar year. Each authorization is recorded per service type per week, with the week's start date.
2. **Lapse.** Where unused hours do not carry into the next period, unused hours lapse at period end. A lapse is recorded per service type per lapsed week.
3. **Visit verification.** Where the tier requires electronic visit verification, hours are delivered only with an EVV confirmation. Each delivered visit is recorded with its visit date, the attendant and its EVV confirmation.
4. **Increments and limits.** Hours are delivered in the tier's billing increment, never more than the tier's maximum hours in one day and never more than the week's authorization.
5. **Correction.** A missing EVV record may be corrected within the tier's EVV correction days of the visit date.
6. **Status.** Hours are authorized and delivered only on an episode in active status, as the system shows that episode's status before the hours are authorized or delivered.

## The weekly check, defined

The hours delivered in a week are the total of the hours on the episode's delivered visits for that Monday to Sunday service week and that service type. A visit may be delivered only while that total, including the visit, stays within the week's authorization for the same service type.

## Worked week (hypothetical)

Hypothetical inputs: a week authorized at 40.00 personal care hours, a daily maximum of 12.00 hours, a 15-minute increment, and EVV required.

| Day | Visit hours | EVV confirmation | Week's delivered total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | 8.00 | Yes | 8.00 |
| Tuesday | 10.50 | Yes | 18.50 |
| Wednesday | 12.00 | Yes | 30.50 |
| Thursday | 8.00 | Yes | 38.50 |

On Friday no more than 1.50 hours can be delivered, because 38.50 hours plus 1.50 hours reaches the 40.00 authorized. A Friday visit of 2.00 hours would take the week past its authorization. A 13.00-hour visit on any day would exceed the 12.00-hour daily maximum, and a visit of 1 hour 50 minutes is not a whole number of 15-minute increments.

## Status check (hypothetical episodes)

| Episode status | Hours may be authorized or delivered |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| On hold | No |
| Outreach | No |
| Closed | No |
